summary: The interface is usable at a glance, but several text and control treatments may make key actions difficult to perceive or operate.

issues.title: Muted text may have insufficient contrast
issues.description: The gray helper text is difficult to distinguish from the light background.
issues.impact: People with low vision or color-vision differences may miss supporting instructions.
issues.recommendation: Use a darker text color and verify at least a 4.5:1 ratio for normal text with a contrast checker.

evidence.observed: Light gray text on a near-white surface

issues.title: Icon control appears small
issues.description: The standalone icon button has a visibly small hit area compared with nearby controls.
issues.impact: People with motor impairments or users on touch devices may have difficulty activating it accurately.
issues.recommendation: Provide a hit area of at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels and include a visible accessible name.

evidence.observed: Small icon with limited surrounding spacing
